capabilities: Add inline comments to prose, code blocks, and tables, stored as HTML comments in the Markdown file
Show comment cards in the margin beside the highlighted text
Reply to, resolve, reopen, edit, delete, and react to comments
Browse and filter comments in a sidebar by open, resolved, or all
Assign per-author highlight colors and repair comments whose markers break the note
extras: The community listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The repository includes an agent skill and validation script for the comment format. Pre-release builds are available through BRAT.
problem: Obsidian has no inline margin comments, and comments stored in a plugin database would be invisible to version control, other editors, and agents reading the raw files.

relations.evidence: The optional Commander plugin can add any of the plugin's other commands to the editor menu.
Notion-style margin comments stored inline in your markdown

summary: Notion-style margin comment plugin that stores inline comments as HTML comments inside Markdown files so other tools can read them.
